name: 99156 · Newport, WA
findings: ZIP 99156 (Newport) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99156 (Newport) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 99156 (Newport) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
